nph.text: Urabrask, the Phyrexian praetor of the Quiet Furnace, lets Mirran survivors take refuge in the Furnace Layer after Phyrexia conquers Mirrodin and seals it from other factions.
He orders his furnace legions to turn a blind eye to the refugees, and when the Mirran resistance arrives his decree stuns the others: "Let them be."
Elesh Norn lays waste to his domain, so the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters while Urabrask's red Phyrexians dwell in the Furnace Layer, and Vraan aids his rebellion against her.
